SELECT u.user_id, u.username,
-- 总计时 IFNULL(SUM(tr.duration) / 60, 0) AS total_minutes,
-- 今年 IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(tr.start_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN tr.duration ELSE 0 END) / 60, 0) AS year_minutes,
-- 本月 IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(tr.start_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(tr.start_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN tr.duration ELSE 0 END) / 60, 0) AS month_minutes,
-- 本周（周一开始） IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(tr.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) THEN tr.duration ELSE 0 END) / 60, 0) AS week_minutes,
-- 今日 IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(tr.start_time) = CURDATE() THEN tr.duration ELSE 0 END) / 60, 0) AS today_minutes
FROM users u LEFT JOIN time_records tr ON u.user_id = tr.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} -- 替换为你实际的用户 ID GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username;
